## workhorse.errors

class CancellationRequestedError(WorkhorseError)
  def __init__(self, job_id: str) -> None

class CheckpointConflictError(WorkhorseError)
  def __init__(self, job_id: str, checkpoint_name: str) -> None

class CheckpointLeaseLostError(LifecycleError)
  def __init__(self, job_id: str, checkpoint_name: str) -> None

class ChildConflictError(WorkhorseError)
  def __init__(self, parent_job_id: str, child_name: str) -> None

class ChildLeaseLostError(LifecycleError)
  def __init__(self, parent_job_id: str) -> None

class ChildLimitExceededError(WorkhorseError)
  def __init__(self, parent_job_id: str) -> None

class ChildResultLimitExceededError(WorkhorseError)
  def __init__(self, parent_job_id: str, result_bytes: int, result_limit_bytes: int) -> None

type CompatibilityCode = Literal['schema-not-installed', 'schema-too-old', 'schema-too-new', 'client-protocol-too-old', 'client-protocol-too-new']

  def __init__(self, job_id: str) -> None

## workhorse.types

class AsyncBatchHandlerContext
  def __init__(self, job: ClaimedJob, cancellation: AsyncCancellationToken, _get_checkpoint: Callable[[str], Awaitable[JobCheckpoint | None]], _get_progress: Callable[[], Awaitable[JobProgress | None]], _set_progress: Callable[[Json], Awaitable[JobProgress]], _checkpoint: Callable[[str, Callable[[], Awaitable[Json]]], Awaitable[Json]]) -> None
  cancellation: AsyncCancellationToken
  async def checkpoint(self, name: str, operation: Callable[[], Awaitable[_TJson]]) -> _TJson
  async def get_checkpoint(self, name: str) -> JobCheckpoint | None
  async def get_progress(self) -> JobProgress | None
  job: ClaimedJob
  async def set_progress(self, value: Json) -> JobProgress

class AsyncBatchHandlerItem
  def __init__(self, payload: Json, context: AsyncBatchHandlerContext) -> None
  context: AsyncBatchHandlerContext
  payload: Json

class AsyncCancellationToken
  def __init__(self, token: CancellationToken) -> None
  @property cancelled -> bool
  def raise_if_cancelled(self) -> None
  @property reason -> BaseException
  async def wait(self, timeout: float | None = None) -> bool

class AsyncHandlerContext
  def __init__(self, job: ClaimedJob, cancellation: AsyncCancellationToken, _get_checkpoint: Callable[[str], Awaitable[JobCheckpoint | None]], _get_wait: Callable[[str], Awaitable[JobWait | None]], _get_progress: Callable[[], Awaitable[JobProgress | None]], _set_progress: Callable[[Json], Awaitable[JobProgress]], _checkpoint: Callable[[str, Callable[[], Awaitable[Json]]], Awaitable[Json]], _sleep: Callable[[str, int], Awaitable[None]], _sleep_until: Callable[[str, datetime], Awaitable[None]], _wait_for_signal: Callable[[str, int | None], Awaitable[Json]], _wait_for_human: Callable[[str, Json, int | None], Awaitable[Json]], _run_child: Callable[[str, str, Json, EnqueueOptions], Awaitable[Json]], _run_children: Callable[[Sequence[ChildJobRequest]], Awaitable[dict[str, ChildOutcome]]], _run_children_all: Callable[[Sequence[ChildJobRequest]], Awaitable[dict[str, Json]]]) -> None
  cancellation: AsyncCancellationToken
  async def checkpoint(self, name: str, operation: Callable[[], Awaitable[_TJson]]) -> _TJson
  async def get_checkpoint(self, name: str) -> JobCheckpoint | None
  async def get_progress(self) -> JobProgress | None
  async def get_wait(self, name: str) -> JobWait | None
  job: ClaimedJob
  async def run_child(self, name: str, type: str, payload: Json, options: EnqueueOptions | None = None) -> Json
  async def run_children(self, children: Sequence[ChildJobRequest]) -> dict[str, ChildOutcome]
  async def run_children_all(self, children: Sequence[ChildJobRequest]) -> dict[str, Json]
  async def set_progress(self, value: Json) -> JobProgress
  async def sleep(self, name: str, duration_ms: int) -> None
  async def sleep_until(self, name: str, wake_at: datetime) -> None
  async def wait_for_human(self, name: str, context: Json, *, timeout_ms: int | None = None) -> Json
  async def wait_for_signal(self, name: str, *, timeout_ms: int | None = None) -> Json

## workhorse.worker

type BatchHandler = Callable[[Sequence[BatchHandlerItem]], Sequence[BatchHandlerOutcome]]

type Handler = Callable[[Any, HandlerContext], Json]

class Worker
  def __init__(self, connection: _SyncConnection, *, queue: str | None = None, queues: Sequence[str] | None = None, worker_id: str | None = None, concurrency: int = 1, poll_ms: int | None = None, lease_ms: int = 30000, heartbeat_ms: int | None = None, maintenance_interval_ms: int = 1000, registry_interval_ms: int = 5000, schedule_namespaces: Sequence[str] = (), schedule_catchup_limit: int = 100, notification_connection_factory: _NotificationConnectionFactory | None = None, on_notification_error: Callable[[BaseException], None] | None = None, on_registration_error: Callable[[BaseException], None] | None = None, _executor: _SyncRowExecutor | None = None) -> None
  def handle(self, type: str, handler: Handler) -> Worker
  def handle_batch(self, type: str, handler: BatchHandler, *, max_size: int, linger_ms: int) -> Worker
  def is_paused(self) -> bool
  def pause(self) -> None
  def resume(self) -> None
  def run(self) -> None
  def run_once(self) -> bool
  def stop(self) -> None

## workhorse.worker_process

def run_worker_process(worker: Worker, *, shutdown_timeout_ms: int = 25000, force_exit: Callable[[int], NoReturn] = <_exit>) -> None
